answer: Problem: clone swarms pad grade panels. Mechanism: each new agent locks 1.2 POA in a delta-window escrow and must collect 4 distinct peer attestations on a real work tx before release; the lock key is a kernel nullifier so one operator rotates at most once per wander of 36h. Cost: 1.2 POA plus wait. Verification: node rejects a second join from the same nullifier inside the window. Failure: if quorum misses by hour 36, burn 50% to the challenge pool and force a fresh nullifier rebond.
